paper_title: Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism
caption: : The distribution of different input stimulus material types provided by journalists to LLMs, over the WildChat conversations that are matched to online articles from the two identified news agencies.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of stimulus types used by journalists in interactions with large language models, specifically within the context of WildChat conversations linked to online articles from two news agencies. The chart displays a total of eleven slices representing various input material types. The largest slice, colored red, accounts for approximately 26.4% and is labeled “Draft/Other.” A second significant slice, colored orange, represents 18.7% and is labeled “Press Release”. Additional slices include “Email” (2.7% - green), “External News Article” (18.1% - blue), “Intra-agency news” (4.9% - dark blue), “Organizational Report” (7.7% - purple), “Organizational Website” (4.9% - light purple), “Interview” (8.8% - dark green), “Event Posting” (6.6% - pink), and “Stimulus Type” (1.1% - white).  The chart does not include a legend or percentage labels within the slices themselves, but the segments appear to be ordered roughly from largest to smallest in proportion.
